sys_script.description:
Prevents duplicate active Inventory Stock records for the same material + location + inventory_type combination. When a batch/lot is specified, the uniqueness check includes the batch. When no batch is specified, only one non-batch record per material + location + inventory_type is allowed.
This supports the multi-warehouse design where each material has exactly one stock record per warehouse per inventory type (with optional batch-level granularity).
Does NOT prevent multiple records for different batches at the same warehouse.
sys_script.name: Prevent Duplicate Stock per Material-Loc
